landing.coverage.heading: Built for payments across African markets.
landing.coverage.body: Availability depends on the licensed partner, service, and country.
landing.trust.heading: Your payment stays with the payment provider.
landing.trust.body: OnwaysPay is a service orchestration platform, not a financial institution. OnwaysPay does not receive, hold, or store customer funds. Financial transactions are executed directly by licensed payment partners and service providers.
landing.trust.one: Sensitive financial processing remains with authorized partners.
landing.trust.three: Follow progress with transaction history and status tracking.
landing.security.intro: Clear responsibilities and partner-led financial processing protect every interaction.
landing.faq.heading: Questions, answered clearly.
landing.faq.intro: Useful answers about payments, coverage, tracking, and vouchers.
landing.faq.help_body: Have a question? We are here to help you.
landing.faq.a1: No. OnwaysPay is a service orchestration platform, not a bank or financial institution.
landing.faq.a2: No. Funds are processed directly by licensed payment partners and service providers.
landing.faq.q3: Which Mobile Money networks are supported?
landing.faq.a3: Available networks depend on your country and current partner coverage.
landing.faq.q4: Can I use OnwaysPay in another country?
landing.faq.a4: Cross-country services are available only on supported routes and through available partners.
landing.faq.q5: How do I track an exchange?
landing.faq.a5: Open your transaction history and select an exchange to view its latest status.
landing.faq.a6: Buy or send a digital voucher, then use its QR code at a participating station.
landing.faq.q7: What should I do if a provider transaction remains pending?
landing.faq.a7: Check the status in your history and follow the support guidance shown for that transaction.

landing.footer.disclaimer: Payments are processed by licensed partners. OnwaysPay does not hold customer funds.
landing.extra.caption: Simple. Connected. By your side.
landing.extra.steps: A simple journey, from choosing a service to confirming your transaction.
landing.extra.africa: A connected Africa, closer to you.
landing.extra.trust: Clear responsibilities to protect every interaction.

landing.detail.availability: Available services are shown in the app and depend on your country and partners.
landing.detail.money.0: Choose the available sending and receiving networks in the app.
landing.detail.money.1: Enter the recipient and amount, then review the transaction details before confirming with the payment partner.
landing.detail.money.2: Find the latest status in your transaction history. Networks and routes depend on your country.
landing.detail.airtime.1: Choose a supported operator, enter the phone number and select an available airtime or data offer.
landing.detail.airtime.2: Check the phone number and offer before authorizing payment with the partner.
landing.detail.fuel.0: Choose a fuel offer available through a participating partner.
landing.detail.fuel.1: Buy an offer for yourself or send one to someone else, then follow the payment steps in the app.
landing.detail.fuel.2: Use the voucher QR code at a participating station and review its conditions before purchasing.
landing.detail.gift.0: Discover the digital gift cards available in the app.
landing.detail.gift.1: Choose a supported card and amount, then authorize payment with the partner.
landing.detail.gift.2: Follow the card instructions to use it or send it to someone you love.
landing.detail.bills.0: View the bill providers available in your country.
landing.detail.bills.1: Select a provider, enter the requested reference, and check the details.
landing.detail.bills.2: Authorize payment with the supported partner.
landing.detail.visa.1: Follow the supported provider instructions to link an eligible bank card.
landing.detail.visa.2: View card information and history made available by the provider.
landing.detail.qr.0: Open a fuel offer that is ready to be redeemed.
landing.detail.qr.1: Present its QR code at a participating fuel station.
landing.detail.qr.2: The station scans the code securely to validate the fuel offer.
landing.support.heading: Need a hand?
landing.support.body: Find answers about services, payments and tracking your transactions.
landing.support.email_body: Email us with your question about OnwaysPay or a transaction.
landing.support.prepare: For a transaction question, keep its reference and current status handy.
